publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.4.1 fixes archive export and restore on Platform-managed installations: Platform migration history stays local and the receiving installation keeps its own ledger. Synthetic API and mail credentials are generated at runtime so the hosted source credential scan accepts the release without exceptions. It includes the shared import door for moving monitor definitions, plus fixes to the release installer journey, runner restart timing and recovery test focus tracking. This patch pins rer 0.2.66. Back up before upgrading: six additive import-door migrations (0050_business_import_door through 0055_business_import_writes) preserve existing monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings. Restored monitors remain paused and alerts quarantined. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png
